_comment: Lines by kind -> archetype (or default) -> band (mid/high, or any). Slots: {speaker} {target} {Target} {room} {item} {about}. {target} becomes 'you' when it is the player. 'reply' lines answer the player's verbs: slots {suspects} {sightings} (chat), {target} (seedDoubt); 'cold' lines are used when they distrust you.

I've been keeping notes. {Target}'s movements trouble me.
Small inconsistencies, all of them around {target}.
Three things don't fit, and all three have {target} in them.
high: I'll say it plainly: {target}. Every thread I pull leads back there.
Look at the pattern, not the person. The pattern says {target}.

any: I... I think a few of us are worried about {target}?

I don't want to be the one to say it, but... {target}.

I'd stake my place on it. {Target} isn't one of us.
{Target}. I'm sorry, but it needs saying.
I'm loyal to the Faithful, and that means naming {target}.
I'd rather be wrong about {target} than silent. I'm not silent.
Funny how {target} has kept so quiet. Not any more.
Let's talk about {target}, shall we?
I've been watching {target}. I don't like what I see.
{Target} smiles too much when people get hurt. I notice these things.
Nobody's looking at {target}. That's exactly why we should.
{Target} is far too comfortable. Far too comfortable.
Doesn't anyone else find {target} a little too helpful?
Where was {target} when the lights went out? Exactly. Nobody knows.
Leave {target} alone. I'd trust them with my life.
{Target} is with me. Look elsewhere.
Whatever you think of {target}, you're wrong.
Put the knives away. {Target} has been straight with every one of us.
{Target} pointed the finger at me. I haven't forgotten.
Remember who accused me, everyone. It was {target}.
Throw mud at me, {target}? Watch it come back.
Found in the {room}: the {item}. It belongs to {target}. I'd like an explanation.
I recovered the {item} from the {room}. We all know whose that is. {Target}?
Look what I found in the {room}! The {item}. That's {target}'s, isn't it?
The {item} turned up in the {room}. {Target}, care to explain?
I found the {item} in the {room}. I don't know what it means, but it frightens me.
Someone left the {item} in the {room}. Someone at this table.
You lay the {item} on the table. "Found this in the {room}. It's {target}'s."
You slide the {item} across the table. "The {room}. Whose do we think this is?"
I saw {target} put the {item} in the {room}. With my own eyes.
Don't let them fool you. {Target} planted that {item}. I watched them do it.
{Target} told me {about} was near the {room}. I checked. It isn't true.
I don't take kindly to being lied to. {About} was never in the {room}, and you know it.
I have to say it... {target} tried to buy my vote.
{Target} offered me something yesterday. To keep quiet. I won't.
That checks out. I saw {target} in the {room} myself.
True enough. {Target} was in the {room}.
I can vouch for that. {Target} was in the {room} when I passed.
The {room}? I had my eye on {target} all day. Not once in the {room}.
No. I watched {target}. They were never in the {room}.
Strange. I was in the {room} myself and {target} was nowhere in it.
You've said nothing. Nothing at all. Why is that, {target}?
Quiet ones worry me most. Isn't that right, {target}?
You've been very quiet, {target}. Too quiet.
Nothing to say, {target}? Interesting.
Silence is a choice. I've noticed yours.
Mistaken. Hm. See that it doesn't happen again, {target}.
A mistake. I'll note it as one. For now.
Easy mistake, I suppose. I'll let it go.
Then one of us is lying, {target}. I know which.
You stand by it? Then I stand by what I saw.
Bold. We'll see who's right.

warm: You've a sharp eye. I could use one.
cold: I'm watching you, you know.
Careful. I remember everything.

warm: Hi! Is everyone okay? Are you okay?
cold: I don't think I should be talking to you.
People are saying things about you...

warm: Whatever happens, I've got your back.

Prove you're one of us.

warm: You're one of the decent ones.

cold: I know what you're like.
Back for another go at me?

warm: Keep your voice down. They listen.
neutral: Why are you talking to me? What do you know?
cold: Stay back. I know what you are.
Everyone's lying. Especially you.

Everyone's so tense. {suspects} {sightings}
Oh, um. {suspects} {sightings} Is that helpful?

sightings.none: I've seen nothing worth mentioning today.

any: {Target}. Noted. I'll check that against what I saw.
Interesting. If it's true, it'll show. If it isn't, that tells me something too.
cold: You seem very keen to talk about {target}. I'll check that. Carefully.

any: Oh no. {Target}? I had a feeling... I'll tell the others.
Really? Everyone said {target} was nice. But you'd know.
cold: Why are you telling me this? ...Alright. {Target}.

any: If you say so, I'll keep an eye on {target}.
{Target}, eh. I'll remember that at the table.
cold: I don't take sides on your say-so. But I'll watch {target}.

any: {Target}. Good. I never liked how they looked at me.

cold: Funny, people keep pointing fingers around here. Including you.

any: {Target}... yes. They're always smiling. Why are they always smiling?
I knew it. I knew it was {target}. Or you. One of you.
cold: Or it's you, trying to make me look at {target}. I'll watch you both.

any: I don't do alliances. But I'll listen, if you've got facts.
cold: No. I'm not done looking at you.

any: Yes! Thank you. I hate being on my own at that table.
cold: I... don't think the others would like that.

any: Then we stand together. I'll say so at the table, whatever comes.
cold: Earn it first.

any: Fine. Just don't ever point at me.
cold: After what's been said about me? You'll have to do better.

any: Why are you so keen to be my friend? What do you want?
cold: Stay back. Friends are how they get you.

any: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.
I... shouldn't. But alright. I won't say your name.
Put it away. You don't need to buy me.
Hm. That's more respect than I usually get.
What's this for? What do you know?

open: The candles are lit. One by one the Faithfuls take their seats, and nobody meets your eye.
Wax pools on the table. Outside, the house settles; inside, six chairs scrape and the talking stops.
The fire has burned low. Someone closes the doors, and the Round Table begins.
A draught bends every flame toward the empty chair. The Faithfuls look at each other, then at you.
silence: An uneasy silence. Nobody wants to go first.
Only the candles move. Everyone waits for someone else to speak.
A long pause. Glances cross the table and find nothing to hold on to.
vote: Pens scratch. Slates turn face down. One by one the names are shown.
The room holds its breath as the slates are turned.
